observations.result: The shared list/search/read/write API and Electron preload/main wiring pass strict TypeScript checking.
Main, preload and renderer bundles compile; the renderer bundle includes the in-place file list, search, Markdown editor and revision-aware save flow.
42 tests and 177 expectations pass across vault safety, Git inspection, core models, API validation and provenance audits.
No unused files, dependencies or exports reported.
No issues in the five changed workspace files relative to 60a55213db2d1061e1254c7c3ae7336c5d912833.

implemented: Vault selection scans in place, exposes read-only Standard/Chronicle state, lists Markdown and unsupported/symlink entries and requires no account.
The isolated renderer can search indexed Markdown, open a note, edit source text and save through the revision-aware IPC writer; Ctrl/Cmd-S is supported.
Unsupported regular files remain visible and disabled instead of being silently hidden or decoded as editor content.
limitations: The Electron binary is not installed locally, so the UI was verified by strict typecheck, bundle compilation, static review and CI builds rather than a visible local runtime launch.
Live preview, reading mode, tabs/splits, command palette, quick switcher, outline/backlinks, settings persistence and dedicated changes review remain P2.2 work.
Reference Obsidian reopen/differential behavior, accessibility automation and cross-platform visible UI checks remain pending.
